cards.name: Entrance

objects.name: StoryField
objects.text: You stand before the Cursed Manor. The iron gate creaks open on its own. Lightning splits the sky.

objects.name: GoInButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Foyer"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Enter the manor

objects.name: FleeButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Escape"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Run away screaming

cards.script:
on openCard
  play "c e g e c"
end openCard

objects.name: StoryField
objects.text: The foyer is lined with portraits whose eyes follow you. A staircase leads up. A door leads to the cellar.

objects.name: UpstairsButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Library"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Go upstairs

objects.name: CellarButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Cellar"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Descend to the cellar

objects.name: StoryField
objects.text: Dusty tomes line every wall. One glows with an unearthly light. A spectral figure points at the window.

objects.name: ReadButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Escape"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Read the glowing tome

objects.name: BackButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Foyer"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Back to the foyer

cards.name: Cellar

objects.name: StoryField
objects.text: The cellar reeks of old earth. Shelves of strange jars line the walls. Something stirs in the corner.

objects.name: InvestigateButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Entrance"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Investigate the corner

objects.name: BackButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Foyer"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Back to the foyer

cards.script:
on openCard
  play "a2 g2 e2 c2"
end openCard

objects.name: StoryField
objects.text: You escape the Cursed Manor — for now. The gate locks behind you. You will be back. They always come back.

objects.name: AgainButton
objects.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card "Entrance"
end mouseUp
objects.label: Return to the manor
